tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog me'i spu gri'i rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so//

'jam dpal yang zlog me'i spu gri'i rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha ya mānta ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pa dag gis nyams su blang bya 'di nyid kho na ste/ de'ang rdo rje slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u drug par gsungs pa ji lta bas gnas dus mtshan nyid dang ldan par zla gsang nag po sogs gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa bshad man ngag sogs rgyud bco lngar gsungs pa'i gdams pa ches zab pa rnams ston cing nyams su len pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po thun mong la bzhi/ lus gnad thun mong bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi zhing mi rtag pa/ dkar nag rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams rang rgyud la 'gre bar bsam/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la bzhi/ skyabs sems/ yig brgya/ maṇḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po skyabs sems ni/ rang gi mdun mkhar gyad seng pad zla nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus mar bla ma rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pas bskor ba/ g.yas su shākya thub pa sangs rgyas stong gis bskor ba/ rgyab tu dam pa'i chos yum sher phyin ser mo/ g.yon du theg chen dge 'dun gyi tshogs/ mdun du yi dam 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la yi dam thams cad kyis bskor ba/ khri'i mtshams rnams su chos skyong srung ma rnams rgyan cha lugs ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar bskyed/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams mdun du gsal btab la skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha// sangs rgyas chos tshogs srung ma la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ */zhes ci mang dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni/

gshed dmar gyi rgyud kyi le'u dang por/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos dang*// tshogs mchog rnams la bdag skyabs mchi// yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don byed phyir| |byang chub sems dag bdag gis bskyed// gang gis bsod nams nyer bsags rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo// 'gro ba kun la phan mdzad phyir// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gyur// ces dang*/ ma rig rgyu las sogs/ snying rje rnam gsum rang rgyud dang 'dres nges par bsgom| mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la bstim mo// gnyis pa yig brgya ni/ rang gi mdun mkhar pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdor sems gshin rje'i gshed dkar po spyan gsum pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa longs sku/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gtod cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa sems dkyil/ dar dang ratna rus pas brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ snying khar hūm̐ mthing rnams las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam ye gnyis med du gyur/ dbang lhar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rdor sems la bstim/ mchod pa bzhis mchod nas/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u nga dgu par/ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las// bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur ston pa// thugs rje'i gzi ldan gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi dbus rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar ya ma rā dza'i yig brgyas bskor ba/

sngags bzlas pa'i tshe gdan sa bon phyag mtshan mi 'gul bar sngags g.yas su myur du 'khor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus/ 'gro sgrib sbyangs lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus thim ma thag /sngags phreng sa bon phyag mtshan sku rnams las bdud rtsi lnga'i rgyun bab/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang sgrib gnyis dag /lus bdud rtsis gang bar dmigs/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs ci nus bzlas/ mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i gnang ba byin par bsam/ rdor sems rang la bsdu'o// gsum pa maṇḍal ni/ mdun du skyabs yul ltar gsal btab la/ maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang*/ sa gzhi spos byug /mnyes byed maṇḍal/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs/ yan lag bdun pa sogs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbul/ phyag 'tshal mthar rang la bsdu'o| |bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun mkhar gyad seng padma zla nyi'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po spyan gsum mtshan dpe'i rin chen rus pa dar gyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol zhing zhabs rdor skyil gyi pang du yum rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma sngon mo g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa rin chen rus pa dar gyis brgyan pa/ skra grol pad skyil yab la 'khril ba/ de la brgyud rim gyi bla mas bskor bar dmigs/ mchod pa bzhis mchod/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ 'das dus rgyal ba klu yi rigs mchog sogs zur du yod pas gsol ba gdab/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar mthing ser bab/ rang gi spyi/ mgrin/ snying*/ lter thim/ sad rmi gnyid 'pho'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ bum/ gsang*/ sher/ bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ sprul longs chos ngo bo nyid sku thob/ mthar brgyud rim rnams gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas 'od du 'bar ba rang la thim pas bla ma'i rdo rje gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/

smin par byed pa dbang dang*/ grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa gnyis so// dang po smin lam dbang gi cho ga bdud dpung zil gnon ltar cho ga yan lag ma nyams shing skyon med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas slob ma'i rgyud la sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i sa bon thebs shing bag chags 'jog pa'i lam/ des 'ong dang*/ des chog /gzu lum dang*/ ral gcod spangs nas tshul ji lta bar skabs 'dir dbang bskur ba shin tu gal che'o// gnyis pa grol lam gyi gdams pa nyams su blang ba la bzhi/ bum/ gsang*/ sher/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor ro// spyi don dang po bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i bskyed rim dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mnyam bzhag /gnyis pa rjes thob/ gsum pa lta ba/ bzhi pa 'da' kha ma/ lnga pa bar do| |drug pa grub mtha'/ bdun pa yon tan/ brgyad pa 'gros/ dgu pa 'bras bu ste dgu las/ dang po bskyed rim rgyas par ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan pa gyur gyi bar ngag 'don kho na ltar cho ga yan lag tshang ba nyid dang*/ bsdu na/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ me ri dang me dpung tsha tsha 'phro ba'i nang du bzhugs pa'i bar gyis gtso rkyang bskyed/ rgyas bsdus gang la'ang ting 'dzin gsum dang mngon byang lnga dang mtshan nyid gsum rnams brda 'phrod cing nges pa rnyed pa rnam dag dran pa logs su bris yod pa ltar/ shin tu gal che'o// de ltar gsal snang thon par byas rjes man ngag zhal shes ltar bzlas pa'ang bya'o// 'dir rdzogs rim rnams kyi sngon 'gro rtsa rlung thig gsum sbyong ba zur du bris yod pa ltar 'dir nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa rjes thob ni dus rtag tu lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar bya'o// gsum pa lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum las/ snang phyogs gsal la ma grub pa'i ngo bo nyid/ stong phyogs med bzhin du gsal ba'i ngo bo nyid/

zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi ngo bo nyid do// bzhi pa 'da' kha ma gong du 'pho ba ni/ 'chi kha snod bcud ma dag pa'i 'khrul pa rten dang brten pa dag pa'i ngo bor bsgyur/ rang sems dngos med rnams 'od kyi gong bur bsgyur/ de nyid rlung sngags hika ces sgra'i snang ba 'pho ba nyid do// lnga pa bar dor dbang dang bdag sems ro gcig pa ni/ bskyed rim la goms pas bar do'i rnam smin gyi lus de nyid skad cig la lha'i skur ldang ba'o// drug pa grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med ni/ snod bcud 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khrul blo spangs nas myang 'das rten dang brten pa'i ngo bor rtogs pas sa drug pa mngon du gyur par man lam 'dis bgrod pa'o// bdun pa yon tan ni/ brgya phrag bdun dang bye ba phrag bdun sogs la dbang 'byor ba'o// brgyad pa 'gros mchog tu thim pa ni/ rtsa lus la lam bskyed rim gyi gnad du bsnun pas tha mal gyi 'khrul snang gsal stong zung 'jug mchog tu thim pa'o// dgu pa 'bras bu ni sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i sku thob pa'o// spyi don gnyis pa gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i rang byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor la yang dgu las/ dang po mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo tsaṇḍa lī bsgom pa ni| bskyed rim bsdus nas rang nyid thun mtshams kyi gshin rje'i gshed zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo g.yon lcags kyu/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan chas phyag drug pa'i skabs ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ lus gnad rkang pa re'u mig tu bsnol/ lag pa pus 'khyud/ rgal tshigs bsrang*/ lus sems 'grims pa'i ngang nas/ rang phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i khong pa'i dbus su rtsa a wa dhū ti sngon po dri chu 'bab pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo khrag 'bab pa/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo khams 'bab pa/ dbu ma'i yas sne spyi bo/ mas sne lte 'og /ro rkyang yas sne klad rgya'i steng nas phyir sna bug gnyis su gug pa/

mas sne dbu ma'i nang du sbud mchu ltar zug pa/ dbu ma'i nang ro rkyang gi sne mo kha gyen du gdang ba'i steng lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su nyi ma'i rang bzhin dmar cha a'i rnam pa kha dog ser po dbu ma'i yas sne spyi bor zla ba'i rang bzhin dkar cha haṃ yig mgo thur bstan du yod par bsam| de'i tshe dmigs lugs bzhi las/ 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa ni/ rlung ro bus/ rgyab rlung tsha ba srin zhal nas yar rngub/ steng rlung bsil ba sna nas mar rngub/ kha sbyar lte 'og tu dgag pa'i tshe/ ro rkyang gi nang du rlung rgyus te bus pas/ a'i mdog dmar lam du gyur/ de las me 'bar je cher du song ba haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ zhu bas byang sems dkar nyil nyil 'dzag pa'i tshe me je chung la song nas gru gsum nang du a yig la lhan gyis thim/ yang me 'bar bas dkar cha yar ldog nas haṃ la thim par dmigs/ de gnyis ka'i tshe bzod med kyi bde stong skyes par bsam/ de ltar yang yang bya'o// spro na/ yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi sogs so sor nyams su blang*/ bsdu na 'di gas chog /drod la dmigs pa ni/ rlung gi a'i me sbar bas/ me cher 'bar bas rtsa gsum gang*/ de nas phyir byung bas lus nang thams cad gang*/ mthar bu ga dgu dang ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas me thon pas lus kyi phyi thams cad g.yogs/ cher 'bar stong gsum gang bar bsam mo// thig le la dmigs pa ni/ sngar ltar me sbar zhing byang sems 'dzag pas snying gar 'phrad/ dkar dmar 'dres pas rtsa gsum dang lus nang thams cad gang bas lus la bde nyams phril phril byung bar bsam mo// mi rtog pa la dmigs pa ni/ lte bar rlung mnan nas ci yang yid la mi byed par/ sngar gyi bde stong lhan skyes de nyid bzod med du bsgom pa yin no// 'di rnams kyi zhib cha bla ma'i ngag nas blang ba gal che/ bde drod myur bar 'dod na rlung bzung nas sgom pa'i tshe/

srin zhal gdang btsum mang du bya ba gnad zab bo// de ltar 'bad pas du ba sogs rtags bcu myur du 'char ba yin no// gnyis pa rjes thob ni/ nyin mtshan kun tu gtum mo'i lam dang mi 'bral bar bya zhing khyad par srod la gtum mo sgom zhing*/ rlung zla gsang man ngag gi rgyud kyi le'u re bzhi par/ mi 'gyur rtsa ba'i srog snying gi// srog ces bya ba rlung yin te// rlung gi rtsa la nges par rgyu// rtsa ni sngar 'dus phyag rgya 'dzin| |gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo yin// zhes so// 'jug oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ dbyung ba hūm̐ du shes pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// gsum pa lta ba rang byung gi ye shes ni/ nyon mongs lnga ma spangs ye shes lnga'i ngo bo las byung ba ye gdod ma'i shes pa/ rnam rtog gang shar 'dzin med chos skur grol ba rang byung ye shes/ gsal stong zung 'jug yangs pa chen po dgag sgrub med pa mtha' bral rang byung ye shes/ tshogs drug der 'dzin spros bral ngo bo stong pa mnyam yang ye 'byams rang byung gi ye shes rnams so// bzhi pa 'da' kha ma 'od gsal ba ni/ 'dzin pa/ sbyar ba/ 'pho ba gsum las/ 'dzin pa ni zla ba gcig tsam dben pa bsten/ ngal dub spangs/ nub snga ma gcig gnyid bcag /phyi nub tshil chen gyi mar me mtshan thub sbar/ grogs dam gtsang gcig rtsar bzhag /lha dang bla ma la 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab nas/ lus gnad tsog pu dang seṅge'i nyal stabs gang bde byas la/ rang phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i sku 'od lus kyi thugs kar padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can sran ma tsam/ mdun gyi 'dab mar a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra rnams 'od kyi rnam par bsam/ bdag gis gnyid 'thug 'od gsal bzung bar bya'o snyam du 'phen pa btang*/ thog mar snang ba thams cad bsdus te a la sems ma yeng bar gtad par snang ba thim pa stong pa'i dus/ gnyid bro ba'i tshe nu la sems gtad pa mched pa thim pa shin tu stong pa'i dus/

gnyid cher bro ba'i tshe ta la sems gtad pa nyer thob thim pa stong pa chen po'i dus/ gnyid du 'gro kha ra la sems gtad pa thob pa 'od gsal la thim pa thams cad stong pa'i dus/ gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe thig le la sems gtad pas 'od gsal gyi ngang du cham gyis 'gro/ de'ang zin na gnyid 'thug gi dran med dang rmi lam sogs mi 'byung bar 'od gsal 'dzin med gsal stong zung 'jug gis dus 'da' ba 'byung*/ grogs kyis zin nam ma zin blta/ zin na dbugs bde/ ngo mdangs che/ gsal la srab pa 'byung*/ ma zin na dbugs mi bde/ ngo mdangs chung*/ mi gsal zhing 'thug pa 'byung*/ zin na de las ma sad kyi bar bzhag /ma zin na de 'phral gnyid bslangs nas slar gong ltar sgom mo// zin nas kyang 'od gsal brtan par bya'o// sbyang ba ni/ nyin snang dang bsre ba ste/ nyin par rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas khams gsum snod bcud rten dang brten par gyur pa 'od du bsdus pa rang la bstims nas/ rang yang 'od gsal stong par 'jug pa ril 'dzin nam ma rgyud kyi chos drug rnams ltar rdzogs rim ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis dang 'di dag go log tu snang mod kyi 'di ni gsang 'dus rim lnga'i lugs yin pas pha rgyud kho na ltar byas so// rang kho na lhar gsal ba 'od gsal stong nyid du 'jug pa rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byor yin pas de gnyis gang rung gi sgo nas nyams su blang ba'i tshe ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang byed kyang rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ting 'dzin sems dpa'/ de'i lte bar sa bon hūm̐ nag po sgom pa'i ngang nas/ ril 'dzin gyis snod bcud bsdus pa'i rjes la rang bsdu ba'i tshe la'ang*/ rjes gzhig gis rang bsdu ba gang byed kyang bdag dam tshig sems dpa' thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim pas snang ba thim pa stong pa'i dus rtags zla 'od lta bu 'ong*/

ye shes sems dpa' ting 'dzin sems dpar thim pas mched pa thim pa shin tu stong ba'i dus rtags nyi 'od lta bu 'ong*/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' sa bon hūm̐ la thim pa'i tshe nyer thob thim pa stong pa chen po'i dus rtags mun pa lta bur 'ong*/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog par mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā dar thim zhing*/ de'ang 'od gsal stong pa nyid du bsdus pa ni thob pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus rtags nam mkha' rkyen gsum dang bral ba tho rangs dus kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu'i sems ni 'od gsal te sbyang zhing goms par byed pa'o// skabs 'dir 'od gsal btsan thabs su 'dzin cing phra rags kyi thim rim ngos 'dzin pa la rdo rje rba rlabs 'ching ba ni shin tu gal che ba'i lag len zhal las shes so// 'od gsal chos skur 'gro ba ni 'chi ba'i tshe rags pa nyi shu/ phra ba bzhi/ shin tu phra ba snang mched thob gsum thim pa so sor ngos bzung nas/ de ma thag 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa yud tsam 'char ba ngos bzung zhing*/ sngar gnyid dang nyin snang la sbyangs pas goms pa'i myong stobs kyis sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar 'od gsal ma bu 'dres ma thag don dam bden pa chos kyi dbyings su 'pho ba ste zhib pa bla ma'i ngag las blang ngo*// lnga pa bar do rang byung ye shes gsal la rtog med ni/ bshad ma thag pa ltar 'chi ba 'od gsal du 'phos pas bar do med par rang byung gi ye shes gzhi thog tu grol ba nyid do// drug pa grub mtha' ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ ji lta ba'i ye shes chos kyi dbyings chos kyi sku rtogs pas/ ji snyed pa 'khor 'das kyi chos dang chos can thams cad la ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ste/ lam 'dis sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin man chad bgrod do// bdun pa yon tan nus pa lnga dang lta stangs gsum la dbang 'byor zhing thob la tshig gi mchog grub cing so so yang dag rig pa bzhi la dbang thob bo// brgyad pa 'gros ngag rlung la lam rang byin brlabs pas lus kyi rtsa mdud yi ger gnas pa rnams grol zhing ye shes kyi rtsa la thim pas tha mal gyi ngag grag stong mchog tu thim pa'o// dgu pa 'bras bu ni longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du grol ba dag go// spyi don gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor la'ang dgu las/

dang po mnyam bzhag tu dngos sam yid kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang po gsum gyi dbye ba ste/ rab ye shes kyi rig ma/ 'bring yid kyi rig ma/ tha ma dngos rig dang gsum las/ rab ye shes kyi rig ma ni/ ye gdod ma'i shes pa la gsal stong gi cha las/ thabs bde ba chen po yab dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid yum gyi rang bzhin du gdod nas grub pa lhan skyes 'du 'bral med par nyams su blangs pas 'gyur bral mchog gi bde ba mngon du byed pa yin la/ 'bring yid kyi rig ma ni/ rang gshin rje'i gshed phyag drug pa'am phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i mdun du/ sbyor yum khrag mig mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab pa'i yab yum 'du shes sum ldan mkha' gsang bsnol mar byin gyis brlabs nas yid kyis snyoms 'jug byas pas/ yas bab lugs 'byung gi dga' ba bzhi dang mas brtan lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong zhing de'i ngo bo lhan skyes bzo med du skyong ba dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// tha ma dngos rig la'ang rang lus dang gzhan lus gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su blang bar bya ba ni bla ma mnyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par bya ba kho na yin no// gnyis pa rjes thob bde chen gyi nyams dang mi 'bral bar bya ba ni/ rang rig gsal ba'i cha bde ba chen po yab thabs kyi rang bzhin/ stong pa'i cha stong nyid kyi yum shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang*/ mtshan mo'i dkar cha shes rab yum dang*| nyin mo'i dmar cha thabs yab kyi rang bzhin dang*/ tshogs drug tu snang ba yab dang de'i ngo bo stong pa yum la sogs pa ste/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos dang chos can thams cad thabs shes snang stong yab yum lhan skyes zung 'jug 'bral med snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa de dag kyang rang mdangs so so la/ rang gshis bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes su gdod nas grub pa la de ltar rtogs shing*/

bcos min bzo med kyi nges shes dang ma bral bar dus kun tu byed pa yin no// gsum pa lta ba yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ byang sems mgrin par bab pas dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes de dag kyang rang gshis bde ba chen po stong pa'i ngo bo gdod nas snang ba der 'dzin las 'das pa'o// bzhi pa 'da' kha ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba ni/ kun rdzob rgyu yi rdo rje sems dpa' bde stong gi lhan skyes snyoms 'jug gi thabs kyis mngon gsum rtogs par 'gyur bas/ 'chi ba'i tshe don dam 'bras bu'i rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rang la yod pa dus der mngon sum du byas pa dag go// lnga pa bar do lhan skyes kyi bde ba ni/ tshe 'dir lam de lta bu la goms pas tshe 'dir lhan skyes rang ngo ma 'phrod kyang bar dor bag chags kyi goms 'dris kyis bde chen lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin mngon sum mi byed pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro// drug pa grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ngu ni/ 'dir kun rdzob byang sems 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba ltar nyams su blangs pas na rgya chung ngu'i tha snyad btags pa yin la/ lam 'dis sa bcu gnyis pa ye shes ldan phyin bgrod par byed do// bdun pa yon tan sku gsum dang ye shes lnga sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ci rigs pa rags pa la dbang 'byor ba yin no| |brgyad pa 'gros 'khor ba 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba dug lta bu'ang 'dod chags nyid 'dod chags kyi sbyor ba 'du shes sum ldan gyi snyoms 'jug gi thab zab mo sngags btab pa lta bus bdud rtsir bsgyur bas sgrib pa der 'dzin bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong ba'i phyir bdud rtsi'i 'gros mchog tu thim pa'o// dgu pa 'bras bu chos kyi sku mtshan ma'i mtha' thams cad spangs pa don dam pa'i sangs rgyas grol bar 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// spyi don bzhi pa tshig dbang dang 'brel ba'i lam rdo rje rba rlabs kyi rnal 'byor la'ang dgu las/

dang po mnyam bzhag zung 'jug gnyis med bsgom pa la'ang*/ gong gi kun rdzob 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde stong bcos mar bsgom par sgyur byas pa las/ ji skad du/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med// ces yan lag bdun ldan du gsungs pa'ang don dam ngo bo nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid du bzhag pas de lta bu'i don nyams su blang ba ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i stong nyid bco brgyad sogs med dgag dang*/ dbu ma pa'i rang gzhan gyis stong tshul sogs blos byas dang*/ phyag rgya'i zhi lhag sogs lam bul ba rnams las ches 'phags pa'i myur lam pho nya'i gdams pa dngos su ngo sprod pa ni/ slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod kho na las rtogs par byos shig /gnyis pa rjes thob de'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing ngo bo bsgom pa la/ sgyu lus kyis sbyangs shing ngo bo lhan skyes su sgom pa nyid yin pas dag pa'i sgyu lus ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sogs gzugs brnyan la bstod smad sogs brtag dpyad mtshan 'dzin gyi sgyu ma'i dpes bcos te bsgom pa ni kun rdzob ste spro na bya'o/ 'dir ni don dam yin tshul gnas lugs kyis gdod nas grub pa'i sgyu lus mtshan 'dzin mthar dbyung ba'i gdams pa ni/ sems rang bab bzhag pas rnam rtog rags pa 'gag pa ni snang ba/ rnam rtog phra ba'ang 'gag pa mched pa/ thams cad rgyun chad pa thob pa/ yang rtog med de'i ngang nas skad cig ma dang por rtog pa zhig thol gyis 'gyu ba snang ba/ de skad cig ma gnyis par snang bar mi sdod par 'gag pas mched pa/ skye 'gag gi mtshams su rtog med rjen gsal thob pa/

yang shes pa yul la 'jug pa snang ba/ de snang gi spu ris 'byed pa mched pa/ shes pa dang yul de'i snang ba mched par thob pa/ gzhan yang gnas na gnas thog tu snang mched thob gsum| 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu snang mched thob gsum/ shar na shar thog tu snang mched thob gsum/ 'gags na 'gag thog tu snang mched thob gsum gyis mtshams sbyar bas mi rtog pa bcos min 'ba' zhig las rtog pa bcos ma btsal yang mi rnyed pa'i brjod bral de ni 'od gsal bar 'jug pa yin la/ 'od gsal de'i ngang nas sems gsal ba'i cha nas lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba ni don dam gyi sgyu lus yin la/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bu de'ang ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gi spros pa las 'das par 'od gsal snang mched mtha' bral rang bab bzo med gcer yan du skyong ba ni don gyi 'od gsal yin la/ tshogs drug gi chos la gcer gyis bltas pas ngo bos stong zhing rang bzhin med pa/ med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor du rtog btags blos byas lung rigs kyis bcos slad byed mi dgos par gdod nas sgyu mar yongs su grub pa nyid de kho na ltar nyams su myong ba ni thun mong ma yin pa don dam pa'i sgyu lus kyi gdams pa dpyis phyin pa yin no| |de'i ngo bo lhan skyes su bsgom pa ni 'di nyid kyi mnyam bzhag gi skabs bshad ma thag pa nyid yin no// thun mtshams rnams su tshogs drug gi yul thams cad rlung sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis sam dpe gtso bo gsum gyis mtshon nas kun rdzob bcos mas kyang sgom pa gal che'o// gsum pa lta ba mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ rgyu mthun/ rnam smin/ skyes bu'i byed pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu ste don dam 'dzag med kyi dga' ba bzhi'o// bzhi pa 'da' kha ma phyag rgya chen pos 'pho ba ni/ 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad chos sku spros bral gyi phyag rgyas thebs pa dag go// lnga pa bar do bde stong mchog gi ye shes ni/

tshe 'dir snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad chos skur rtogs pa la tshe 'di phyi bar gsum zhes dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ kha rtsang dang*/ mdang dang*/ de ring gsum dus tha dad kyang sems nyid la dbye ba med pa bzhin no// drug pa grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po ni/ 'dir 'dzag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bde ba las 'das pa 'dzag med don dam pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde stong dbyer med yin pas na rgya chen po zhes tha snyad btags pa la lam 'dis sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pas de'i gong na go 'phang gzhan med pa'i phyir na rgya chen po zhes btags so// bdun pa yon tan ni/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo don dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i phyir de'i yon tan thams cad la dbang 'byor ba yin no// brgyad pa rlung gi 'gros mchog tu thim pa zhes rlung sems tha mi dad pa'i phyir sems 'khrul pa'i dri ma rtsad bcad nas don gyi ye shes kyi ngo bor mchog tu thim pa dag go// dgu pa 'bras bu ni/ sku gsum tha dad med par ngo bo nyid kyi sku grol ba yin no// zhes pa nas mi bslu ba'i yang dag pa'i nges pa kho na'o// gsum pa rjes phran bu'i gdams pa la/ lam de lta bu bsgoms pas drod thob bam ma thob kyi mtshan ma rmi lam gyis 'dzin pa dang*/ tshe 'dir ma grol na bar ma dor cis kyang grol bar bya ba dang*/ lam bsgoms pa'i 'phror tshe'i dus byas nas 'pho bas mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ zab pa'i man ngag bsre ba rnam drug dang*/ rgyun 'khyer lam gyi snying po dang*/ shin tu bsdus pa bar dor 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa dang*/ lta sgom spyod pa rgyud nas gsungs pa bstan pa dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ gong gi nyams len la drod thob na rmi lam la gnad du bsnun mi dgos par chos thams cad kyi ngo bo 'od gsal stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du rnam pa rmi lam sgyu ma kho nar 'char ba yin la/

de tsam gyi drod ma thob na rmi lam btsan thabs kyis bsgom pa ni/ nyin snang thams cad rmi lam yin snyam par bslabs nas/ mtshan mo rang dam tshig sems dpa' phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i mgrin par padma'i lte bar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig bsam/ gnyid log khar do nub bdag gis rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya'o snyam du 'phen pa btang*/ thig le de las 'od 'phros pas lus bde bas khengs/ sems gsum 'od du zhu ba thig le la thim pas sems ma yeng bar thig le la gtad nas gnyid log /rmi lam rmi lam du shes na zin pa yin/ de ltar lan 'ga' zin nas sbyang ba ni/ lha'i gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams sogs ngo mtshar sna tshogs blta ba dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi la ya nga ba med par stong pa thal byung sogs la slob cing sbyang*/ 'byongs nas sprul pa ni/ gcig la mang po dang*/ mang po gcig tu bsdu ba sogs la bslab/ de 'byongs nas bsgyur ba ni| sems can sangs rgyas dang*/ me chur sgyur ba sogs la bslab/ de 'byongs nas/ mthar nyin mtshan bsres te/ nyin snang yang mtshan mo'i rmi lam ltar snang stong du shes shing sbyang*/ sprul sgyur la bslab/ de ltar nyin mtshan snang ba thams cad sgyu mar shes pas/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring 'chi kha/ tha ma'ang srid pa bar dor mi grol bar mi srid pa ni nges pa'o// gnyis pa tshe 'dir mchog ma grub na'ang bar dor cis kyang grol ba'i gdams pa ni/ sku gsum ste chos skur grol ba ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur rtogs pa nyid yin pa ni sngar gsang dbang gi 'da' kha ma ltar yin la 'di'i zhib cha ni bla ma'i ngag ltar sbyar/ longs skur grol ba ni/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal ngos ma zin pa'am/ de'i ngang du 'jog ma nus na/ bdag shi ba dang bar do yin pa ngos bzung nas/ bar do'i snang ba lha'i bskyed rim du skad cig la ldang ba dang*/

mngal sgo dgag pa'i sbyor ba bla ma'i zhal shes ltar nyams su blangs pas longs skur grol ba yin no// de yang ma nus na/ sprul pa'i skur grol ba ni/ bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes shing lam du blangs pas ma dag pa'i mngal 'dor zhing dag pa'i mngal du 'jug pa'i gdams pa ni/ thog mar 'khrul snang du mngal gyi snang bar dag pa dang ma dag pa'i mngal du mi'i mthong snang byung ba'i tshe/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam dang dud 'gro'i gnas la sogs pa spangs nas/ lha khang dang*/ skyed mos tshal/ mchod rten la sogs pa dag pa'i gnas rnams blang*/ pha ma 'du 'phrod spyod pa'i tshe/ bla ma yab yum yi dam yab yum du bsgoms nas gsang ba'i dbang zhus pa slar sems can gyi don du sprul sku thob 'dod kyi bsam pas nying mtshams sbyar bas gnad che zhing*/ 'di la mngon byang lnga dang sbyor ba sogs zhib cha bla ma'i gsung las blang ngo*// gsum pa lam bsgoms pa'i 'phror shi na 'pho bas mtshams sbyor ba la'ang*/ rab 'od gsal chos skur 'pho ba ni/ 'chi khar spyi don gyi 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po las ma g.yos par mnyam par bzhag pa de'i ngang la shi na/ sngar 'od gsal gyi nyams len la goms nas 'chi ba'i 'od gsal skad cig ma dang po dang 'dres te/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal chu la chu bzhag pa ltar ro gcig tu gyur pas de ma thag chos skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// 'bring gi sgyu lus longs skur 'pho ba ni/ sngar 'od gsal stong nyid du 'jug cing de las lha sku sgyu mar ldang ba'i nyams len la goms pas/ 'chi khar phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag cing bskyed rim goms pa 'chi ba'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rlung g.yos pas/ rnam rtog 'char du nye ba'i tshe lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang skad cig la krong gis langs nas bar do sgyu ma 'od gsal gyi mes sbyangs te bar do mi dgos par longs skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// tha ma bskyed rim sprul skur 'pho ba ni/

sbyang ba dang las la sbyor ba gnyis las/ sbyong ba'i tshe lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ rang phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas gsang gnas bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po drang thal le ba'i mas sne rtsa ba'i rlung rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bo yaṃ sngo skya/ snying gar rang sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag /tshangs bug rgya gram gyis bkab par bsam/ 'tshog ma smin mtshams mig sna rna ba kha lte ba bshang chu ste dgu po hūm̐ e nag po re res bkag par mos la/ nywa bzhi'i sha bsgrim/ mig rlung gyen du bsgril/ 'og sgo gnyis 'then la/ hika drag po mang du brjod pa'i tshe lus kyi yan lag gi rlung rnams rtsa ba'i rlung lnga la thim/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yaṃ la thim/ yaṃ gyen la drag tu bteg pas snying ga'i hūm̐ phul nas spyi bo'i rgya gram la thug par shugs drag pos 'phar bar bsam/ 'byongs rtags spyi dang 'dra/ thun mtshams su kā zhes yig 'bru so sor phab la srog rtsol gyi rlung bum pa can la 'bad do// las la sbyor ba ni/ 'chi rtags rdzogs nas/ dus la bab pa'i tshe yo byad rnams spong dag tshogs gsog bya/ bla ma yi dam la mchod gtor phul nas 'chi ba lam du lhong bar gsol ba gdab/ zhing sbyong gi 'phen pa btang zhing 'pho ba'i dmigs pa sbyong ba'i dus ltar yang yang gsal gdab/ 'chi ba la nye ba'i tshe spyi bo'i rgya gram med par bya/ sgo dgu'i yi ge rnams gsal bar bsam zhing*/ hika sogs gong ltar las/ hūm̐ tshangs bug tu thon par bsam| 'chi ba'i tshe yaṃ hūm̐ la thim ma thag skar mda' ltar hūm̐ myur bar tshangs bug tu thim par bsam/ hika bya/ rang gis hika ngag nas ma thon pa la thug pa'i tshe rang gi dmigs pa gsal zhing*/ grogs kyis hika drag po brjod cing spyi bo'i skra nas 'then bzhin par nyon mongs kyi rtog pa med par dmigs pa de ga'i ngang du 'pho/ mthar 'phos zin nas sngar gyi 'od gsal lam sgyu lus bde drod gang rung gi gdams pas mtshams sbyar bas sprul skur 'tshang rgya ba yin no// gzhan la gdams pa sogs zhal las shes so// yang long med btsan thabs su 'pho dgos pa las dbang gzhan rkyen gyis gsod pa la thug pa sogs mtshams sbyor ngan pa 'byung du nye na/

rlung drag tu bzung la bskyil/ rba rlabs cher bcing*/ rig pa hūm̐ nag gcer bu khong pa nas brgyud tshangs bug tu rgyang gis thon nas 'og min du 'pho bar dmigs pa gsum/ dus gcig tu drag la myur bar byas pas mi 'pho mi srid pa yin mod kyi shin tu gsang ba gal che'o// yang 'pho ba'i gdams phran rnam shes grong 'jug gi gdams pa sbyang ba ni/ rlung sems la drod cung zad thob nas bya ba ste/ sbyang ba dang*/ 'jug pa gnyis so// dang po sbyang ba ni| ha cang mtshan ngan rang ma yin pa'i pho thod dum bu gcig pa nas lnga pa'i bar gang yang rung bar dri bzang dang*/ rtsi nag gis nag por byugs pa'i nang du hūm̐ dkar po bris pa mdun du maṇḍal gyi khar sgreng thabs su bzhag /skyabs sems bya/ bla ma bsgom/ rnam shes grong 'jug gi gdams pa myur du 'byong bar gsol ba btab/ de nas rang nyid phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar rnam shes hūm̐ dmar po'i rnam par bsam/ de nas rlung bzung la hika brjod pas/ rnam shes hūm̐ gi rang bzhin sna bug g.yon nas skar mda' ltar song*/ thod pa'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing hika mang du brjod/ dmigs pa shin tu gsal zhing rnam shes dang rlung 'grogs pa shin tu gal che/ 'byongs rtags su thod pa dros pa dang*/ 'tshag pa dang*/ 'phar ba dang*/ 'gul ba sogs 'byung zhing rang nyid dran pa nyams pa 'byung ngo*// 'byongs nas grong 'jug dngos ni/ rigs bzang zhing ha cang rgas pa ma yin pa dang*/ gri mdze dme sogs 'chi rkyen ngan pa ma byung ba'i ro rma med pa blang*/ spos chus bkru dri bzang byugs la snying khar mtshal gyis nṛ bris pa maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhag /skyabs sems bsgom/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la tshogs gtor 'bul/ grong 'jug gi gdams pas 'gro don nus pa'i gsol ba gdab/ dmigs pa gzhan 'dra la/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ gi tshab tu nṛ bsgom/ rang gi sna bug g.yon dang ro'i sna bug g.yon sprad pa'am mi sprad kyang rung*/

gong ltar rlung sems gnad kyi sbyor bas hika dang rnam shes kyi nṛ ro'i snying ga'i nṛ la yang yang bstim/ ro 'gul zhing rang dran pa nyams pa'i tshe grogs kyi hika dang 'pho ba'i 'dun pa gsal gdab/ rang shi zhing ro dran pa rnyed nas grogs kyis ro dran pa rnyed pa de'i rna bar mchu gtad rang ming nas 'bod cing dran pa gsos btab/ rlung bcos dang bur chang sbyin/ ro rnying pa 'gol sar sba/ ro la 'phos pa des sems dran pa brtan par gyur nas ro snga ma la drin lan gyi tshul du bsag sbyang sātstsha bya/ lus gsar pas 'gro don gang 'grub bya'o// des rgan pa las gzhon par langs nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin no// rnam shes grong 'jug gi man ngag 'di ni rlung sems la brtan pa cung zad thob na nges par 'byung ma thob pas mi bya'o// bzhi pa zab pa'i man ngag bsre ba rnam drug gi nyams len gong ma rnams kyis kha bskangs te/ gnyid 'od gsal du bsre ba ni/ gnyid log khar sems ma yeng bar 'od gsal mi rtog pa kho na'i ngang du gnyid log pas/ rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa mi 'byung bar gnyid 'od gsal du me re gnas pa 'byung ngo*// rmi lam sgyu lus dang bsre ba ni/ rmi lam gyi 'dzin sbyong byas nas snang ba thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par khyer bas nyin mtshan dbyer med pa 'byung ngo*// 'chi kha ma 'od gsal dang bsre ba ni/ 'chi kha sems 'od gsal las ma g.yos par bzhag pas 'chi sems kyi tha ma rnams 'od gsal la thim pa ngos zin na chos sku thob pa la tshegs med do// bar do zung 'jug dang bsre ba ni/ bar dor rlung sems 'od lus dang ldan pa de zung 'jug longs sku snang la rang bzhin med par shes par byed pa yin no// snyoms 'jug bde stong dang bsre ba ni/ thabs shes sbyar ba'i chags pa bar mi dus kyi bde ba la stong pas rgyas btab ste bde stong gnyis med zung 'jug tu 'jog pa yin no// longs spyod bde stong dang bsre ba ni/

'dod yon mtha' dag la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ bden zhen dang sred chags spangs te bde stong gi ngang nas the tshom dang rtog pa med par ci bder longs spyod pa yin no// lnga pa rgyun khyer lam gyi snying po ni/ de ltar gong du bshad pa rnams nyams khrid du nyams su blangs pas rtag dang rtags can la sogs pa drod tshad gtan la phebs nas/ lam mdor bsdus rgyun 'khyer du bya ba'i tshe bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'dus te/ thog mar ngag 'don yongs su rdzogs par grub nas srung sngags ci rigs pa bzlas rjes man ngag gi rim pas yi ge bcu bdun pa gnyis sam/ bcu gcig pa gang 'grub bzlas rjes bsdu rim ltar bsdus nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis nyin snang sgyu ma ltar sbyang zhing bar do'i snang ba la slob pa dang*/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa sbyong zhing dngos sam yid kyi rig ma la snyoms 'jug dang*/ lus lhar gsal bas rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ ste rlung sngags dbyer med rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i ngang nas/ sems 'od gsal snang med bde stong zung 'jug las ma g.yos par spyod lam thams cad de'i ngang nas chos dang mthun par spyad/ nam srod la gtum mo 'bar 'dzag drod thig le mi rtog pa la dmigs pa bzhi sngar ltar nan cher bsgom/ gung la rmi lam 'dzin sbyong sprul bsgyur la bslab/ tho rangs skya rengs dang po 'char du nye ba nas nyi ma ma shar bar du 'od gsal 'dzin pa la sbyang ba yin no// 'chi kha'i gdams pa de rnams la dgag pa gsum/ gzer drug |stobs lnga'i gnad ldan par bya ste/ dgag pa gsum las/ 'khor bar skye ba'i bag chags kyi sa bon dgag pa ni/ rang lha sku bsgom 'chi kha'i 'tshang rgya ba'i dran 'dun gyi shes pa gtong*| 'chi ba'i bla ma'am grogs dam ldan gyis rang gi rna ba g.yas pa nas yi dam gyi lha dang 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal gdab/ rna ba g.yon pa nas sems bde gsal mi rtog phra ba ste phyag rgya bzhi po gsal btab nas 'phor 'jug pa rnams so// bar do'i snang ba dgag pa ni/

shi nas zhag bzhi phyed dang bzhi tshun la ma shi ba'i snang ba 'char/ de nas shi bar shes nas bar do'i snang ba dang 'gro drug gang gi lus len pa'i gzugs snang sogs bar do'i snang rtags rnams 'byung bas de dgag pa ni/ zas nor gnyen 'dun gang la'ang mi chags par/ lha sgom/ spyod pa sbyang*/ zung 'jug gi ngang du gnas pa rnams so// skye ba dgag pa ni/ bar do'i lus bor ba bzhin byas nas 'tshol zhing skye gnas kyi khyad par gyi chags sdang mig ser sogs 'byung ba'i tshe/ snga phyi'i lus la mi rtog pa bsgom zhing srid pa spang ba dang grogs mi 'dug snyam nas lus la skyug log pa dang*/ pha ma yi dam du shes shing sku gsum thob 'dod kyi bsam pa rnams so// gzer drug las 'od gsal zin pa'i gzer gsum ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe ngu skad la sogs pa 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng med pa dang*/ 'od gsal zin pa'i dran 'dun sngon du yang yang gtong ba dang*/ sngar bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'chi ba'i tshe 'od gsal goms pa brtan pas ma yeng bar 'jog pa rnams so// zung 'jug zin pa'i gzer gsum ni/ ye shes skye ba'i yul bar do yin par ngo shes pa dang*/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang snyam pa'i 'phen pa sngon nas yang yang gtong ba dang*/ da lta nas chos thams cad gnyis med kyi ngang du goms par byed pa rnams so// stobs lnga ni/ gnas lugs kyi stobs kyis sems nyid 'od gsal du gnas pa/ shi ba'i stobs kyis 'od gsal 'char ba'i dus la bab pa/ gdams ngag gi stobs kyis 'od gsal chos skur ngos zin pa/ bar do'i stobs kyis rlung sems kyis lus longs skur snang ba/ sngar gyi sbyangs pa dang 'phen pa'i stobs kyis zung 'jug ye shes kyi skur ldang ba ste/ gnad 'di rnams la goms na bar dor 'tshang mi rgya ba mi srid pa yin no// drug pa de tsam mi nus na gdams pa shin tu bsdus pas kyang bar dor 'tshang rgya ba ni/

rim pa lnga'i gnad dang sbyar te/ stan bde bar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'brur thig le dkar po'i lte bar a shad nag pos mtshan pa de rnams sen mo zlum pa tsam zhig bsam/ de'i ngang nas dang po rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi rlung ma bcos rang bab sna bug nas phar 'gro ba'i tshe hūm̐ yig dpag tu med pa thon/ sprul pa'i skur gyur pas 'gro ba'i don byas/ tshur rngub pa'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad oṃ gyi rnam pa mang por gyur/ rtse mgo nas mar bde stong gi ngo bor zhu ba longs sku nang du gnas pa skye 'gag dang bral ba chos skur bsgom zhing gdod nas de ltar yin pa la yin par shes nas lan ci rigs bya'o// gnyis pa sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa ni/ lha sku padma thig le a shad dang bcas pa gsal bar bsgoms nas sems lha sku la ma yeng bar 'jog pa ni snang ba dang po thim pa stong pa'i ye shes yin/ de nas padma la sems ma yeng bar gtad/ de ni mched pa thim pa shin tu stong ba'i ye shes yin/ de nas thig le la sems gtad/ de ni nyer thob thim pa stong pa chen po'i ye shes yin/ 'di rnams la dmigs pa dar gcig re bsgom zhing dmigs pa re re'i dus steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung ngo*// gsum pa sgyu lus kyi rim pa ni rang lhar gsal ba'ang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu gsal la rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' lta bu/ gcig gis kun la khyab pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu sogs sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon nas bsgom zhing tshogs drug sgyu mar sbyang*/ bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi rim pa ni/ lha sku padma la bsdu/ padma thig le la/ thig le a shad la/ a shad kyang kha dog dang dbyibs ngos bzung ci yang ma grub pa sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bur sems gsal la mi rtog par sing nger bzhag

/'chi dus kyang 'di'i ngang la 'chi bas 'chi ba 'od gsal du tshud par gdon mi za'o/ lnga pa gzungs sngags kyi rim pa ni/ 'od gsal rtog med de'i ngang nas rtog pa med bzhin du rang gar sdod/ 'og min gyi gnas su rang gtso bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs longs sku 'khor sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs dpag tu med par mchod pa 'bul zhing chos nyan pa de'ang bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang du bsgom/ de ltar da lta goms shing 'dris par bsgoms pas bar dor 'tshang rgya ba ni mi bslu ba'o// 'di'i skabs lha sgom pa ni rdzogs rim gyi rten ye shes kyis bskyed pa yin pas skad cig gi lam gyis bsgoms shing spyan 'dren sogs cho ga'i yan lag rnams sgrub mi dgos pas so// bdun pa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i lta sgom spyod pa bstan pa la gsum/ dang po lta ba bstan pa ni/ zla gsang me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ snang srid dbyings nas mya ngan 'das// spros bral mi 'gyur gdod nas dag /dag pa nyid la thams cad gsal// shes dang shes byed ngang gis bstod// chu zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du gsal// 'di ni yid bzhin rin po che// thams cad re ba rdzogs byed pa'i// e ma hoḥrdzogs par rab dka' ba// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi mkhyen na// gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi dbyings// 'gro kun yongs la a cang che// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ lta ba 'di la gang gnas pa'i skyes bu'am rnal 'byor pa de'i skal pa bzang ba yin te/ des ni/ las kyi rim pa brgya phrag brgyad/ rtsa ba gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir// sbyor ba nyis brgya stong bcu drug /dka' ba med par len par gsungs// the tshom med pa'i sems kyis su// de bas 'di la nan tur bya// zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun par/ lta ba'i dam tshig chen po 'di// med pa phyal ba gcig pu nyid// ye 'byams ye nas ye gsal khyab// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa sgom pa ni/

'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu par/ gzhi la sangs rgyas 'khor ba'i rgyu// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// bdag nyid dpal chen gshin rje'i sku// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ dang po'i gnas pa dag bya'i phyir// sku lnga 'khor lo'i tshul du bsgom// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don ni bshad ma thag pa'i nyams len rnams so// gsum pa spyod pa ni gnyis/ dang po kun rdzob ni/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun par/ ma yeng bsam gtan ting 'dzin brtan// gsang ba'i lam min gzhan mi 'gro// rig pa mnga' min phyag mi 'tshal// mi smra bar ni sha chen za// g.yang gzhi stag lpags ro gos gyon| |dur khrod gnas phyin phreng chen bgrang*// zhes sogs dang*/ 'jam dpal dri ma med pa gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u drug par/ lta ba spyod pa gnyis med pa'i// smyung ba dag la gnas pa'i tshe| |stag lpags gyon dang bgrod dkar 'gro// gdug pa dom gyi lpags dmar 'ding*// sdigs mdzub sgreng zhing be con 'phyar// seng ldeng be yi og 'khar 'dzug /zas dang skom du bdud rtsi za// mi rkang mchog phur mtshon du thogs// phyag mi 'tshal zhing lam mi gzur// ral pa muñdza cod pan bcing*// ma yeng mtshon chen ral gri 'chang*// zhes dang*/ zla gsang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun cu don gsum par/ klu yi le'u ting 'dzin spel// na raka dong sprug la sogs 'don// gtor ma dbul zhing sātstsha gdab// ma yeng drag tu a kro 'don// zhing yid mos pa spyad// 'jam dpal rgyun sgom raksha bgrang*// be con thogs te lam mi gzur// chas brgyad gyon te sha chen mur// spyod lam rgyun gyi dam tshig dag tu gsungs/ zhes dang*| |'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu par/ rgyun du nam yang dam du gnas// dpa' brtul tsha rngam spyod pa bya// sdigs mdzub phyar zhing gdug pa 'dul// zhes dang*/

'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu par/ dus gsum rnam par mchod pas mchod// 'du 'dzi spangs la dgon par gnas// tshogs rgyun sha dang khrag la rol// mchod dang maṃ sa zas su rol| |zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams spyod do// gnyis pa don dam pa'i spyod pa ni/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u bdun par/ chos rnams ma lus kun gyi gzhi// sngags 'chang go 'phang bsgrub pa'i srog /ngo bo chos sku byang chub sems// 'khor 'das lhun grub ngang du rdzogs// zhes dang*/ zla gsang me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ e ma hoḥ 'khor ba nyid na mya ngan 'das// rgyu nyid 'bras bu dag pa'i don// srid pa mya ngan nyid 'das pas// bdag cag grol bar deng gyur to// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa rnams so| |de ltar bshad pa'i smin grol bskyed rdzogs kyi lam tshang la ma nor ba 'di rnams ches dkon zhing nyams su blangs nas gdams ngag gzhan las phan yon nus stobs che ba'ang*/ 'jam dpal dri ma med pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u nyer gnyis pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang ma bral zhing*// byams pa la sogs ma bral na// rang sems rnam par dag gyur te// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur// dngos grub ster bar rang sems shes// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ de ltar rang sems dag pa la/ dus gsum bde gshegs mngon phyogs shing*// de bzhin chos skyong mgon po dang*// rnal 'byor ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dang*// 'jig rten las kyi mthu chen rnams// ring por gnas nas sdong grogs byed// ces dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i cho ga zhib mo khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud kyi le'u drug par/ snying brtse bzod dang de bzhin byams// rang bzhin gyi ni snying po can// ji skad bstan pa'i sngags pa ni// byang chub sems gnyis sems byed la// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kun// gdon mi za bar de la 'grub// ces dang*/

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i sbyor ba'i le'u bzhi par/ gang zhig ltos pa med pa'i mi// grub pa myur du 'tshol byed na// sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag par// rdo rje 'dzin pa de 'grub 'gyur// dngos po gang dang gang spyod yul// de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gro// mnyam bzhag mnyam par mi bya la// dus rnams rtag tu rnal 'byor pas// shin tu mnyam par bzhag par bya// des ni thar pa nyid kyi rgyu// rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las ni// 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur byed de// dka' ba med pa'i thabs 'di ni// dka' spyod brtul zhugs rnams spangs nas// shin tu bde ba bsgrub ba'i thabs// sdug bsngal 'jigs med bdud rtsi'i ro// blo ldan legs par blang bya ste// shin tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya// mi shes blo gros rmongs pa 'ga'// rtog pa'i dra bas sgrib pa'i tshe// bsod nams dang ni sdig pa yi// phung po rnam pa gnyis su blta// 'on kyang 'dod pa thams cad ni// rgyud mchog 'di las 'byung 'gyur phyir// dman zhing brtson pa chung ba 'ga'// 'di la zhugs na myur du 'grub// de bas ngo mtshar rgyud 'di ni// rnyed dka' khyad par mchog gyur pa// yi ge'i dbyibs kyang mi bstan na// bshad cing 'grol ba smos ci dgos// zhes so// de ltar dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i nyams len rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyang slob dpon mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod nas de nyid dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba kho na las rtogs par bya dgos kyi/ 'dir ni rtsa ba'i tho sa bcad tsam bkod nas man ngag gi gnad phal cher zhal gyi padmor gab pa kho na nyid yin te/ rgyud de nyid las/ dbang rnams legs par ma blang zhing*// bla ma mnyes par ma byas tshe// bstan kyang thob par mi 'gyur ro// tsha ba la sogs 'khor bar 'khor// zhes so// slob dpon mnyes pas man ngag ma tshang med par gnang yang rang gis ma bcang zhing nyams su ma blang ba dang*/

gzhan snod min mtshan nyid med cing ma smin pa la spel na dngos grub mi 'thob la/ de nas ldog pas grub par 'gyur ba'ang*/ de nyid las/ rang gis shin tu bcangs byas shing*/ dngos grub nyid bzhin mngon byas na// sdug bsngal mtha' dag nges zad nas// myur du bla med thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa kho na nyid do// de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog me'i spu gri'i rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rtsa ba gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud zla gsang nag po sogs bka' gter rtsa bshad man ngag gi rgyud chen po bco lnga'i lta sgom spyod pa rdzogs rim gyi man ngag gsungs pa rnams rtsa bar bzhag /gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs rgyud sde nang mthun pa rnams kyis kha bskangs/ gsang 'dus rim lnga sogs pha rgyud rigs gcig pa bstun du mi rung ba ma yin pa rnams dang yang bstun/ gnas skabs su rjod byed tshig nyung zhing*/ brjod bya gsang sngags pha rgyud kyi rdzogs rim gyi gnad ma tshang ba med pa shin tu rgya che zhing zab par bgyis pa'ang*/ dbur stod 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las gshin rje'i gshed kyi lam rim pa gnyis la dbang 'byor ba/ chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang gi dran pa gso ba dang*/ gzhan 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i blos me glang zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes bcu la/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug klung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig lcang lo can du 'bad pas bkod pa yin gyi/ 'di la rang bzo dang 'khrul pa'i dri ma yod par mi sems kyang rmongs pa'i 'khrul blo 'ga' zhig mchis na mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags par bgyi la/ man ngag 'di dbang ma thob pa dang*/ lam 'dir mi mos pa dang*/ thob grangs brtsi zhing nyams su mi len pa dang*/ rang ma grol bar 'phyor chas/

khengs grags/ rnyed brtson gyis gzhan la ston pa'i phyir zhu ba sogs dam med snod min 'chal po kha mkhas snying ring can rnams la bstan na las kyi gshin rje dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas nyams pa'i slob dpon dang slob ma de dag gi mgo bo tshal par khos shig /snying khrag thang la phos shig /sa ma ya na rakkan// yi ge pa ni rje nyid kyi grwa 'bangs kyi tha shal 'phyongs rgyas pa ngag dbang bdag gis dad 'dun kho nas bris pa lags// //maṅga la shrī dzwa la dzambu dwīpa a laṅkār ā gatstshaḥ shu bhaṃ stu sarba dza ga taṃ//
